record.body:
## Rationale

The assessment is the authority on what evidence means; a check-run does not choose the status or the stage.

## Counter-argument

Deriving from check-runs gives a status on every row before anyone assesses, which is the common state mid-phase.

payload.alternatives: Derive a status from the latest check-runs
payload.choice: A requirement with no assessment shows unassessed with the latest check-run result dimmed
